findings.issue: MODALITY FLIP. The line continues into 02_30 'for my triumphant return', a purpose adjunct, so 'must' here is deontic/purposive — he has to be fattened up for the occasion (cf. Interact_12_10 'Stop feeding me', Interact_Lazlo_06_20 'Locked away like this'). لا بدّ أنّي is epistemic — 'I must surely BE exquisitely fat' — an inference about his present state, which cannot govern a purpose clause. The Arabic reads as vanity about how fat he already is instead of the black joke that he is being fattened deliberately.

Same node family as 09_10_Pos. The implied subject of 'how small' is the tribute/offering, and every Arabic noun used for it in this corpus is feminine (جزية، عطيّة، مساهمة). Masculine صغيرًا has no antecedent it can agree with.

Unvocalised نضجت is readable as نضجتَ ('how YOU have matured') as easily as نضجتُ ('how I have matured'), and the preceding line 11_20 is addressed to Lazlo ('Go and tell him what you’ve seen'), which actively primes the second-person reading. That inverts who the boast is about.
